## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The introductory exposition (*xuánshì* 懸示, "hanging-display") volume of [通理](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E7%90%86) Tōnglǐ's four-text *Fǎhuá jīng zhǐzhǎng shū* commentarial complex (see [KR6d0095](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0095)). Provides the doctrinal-historical introduction to the *Zhǐzhǎng shū* main commentary ([KR6d0097](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0097)).

**Abstract**

The *Xuánshì* belongs together with [KR6d0095](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0095) (the *kēwén*) as the principal navigational-introductory apparatus to Tōnglǐ's *Zhǐzhǎng shū* main commentary ([KR6d0097](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0097)). The two together fulfill the function of the standard Tiāntái scholastic *Wǔzhòng xuányì* introductory framework, providing the structural and doctrinal orientation needed for productive engagement with the main commentary.
